method: Utilities: a live `command -v` probe inside the bashrc of that build (one bash call, probeScript in lib/caps.js).

snappyHexMesh keys: a live `grep -c <key>` against the build's own `etc/caseDicts/annotated/snappyHexMeshDict` — that build's documentation, not a version table; for org14 it was additionally checked against the sources (`src/mesh/snappyHexMesh/...`).
Every value below was re-checked on 2026-11-26 against the installed builds: com2606 (env/openfoam/com2606), com2512 (/usr/lib/openfoam/openfoam2512), org14 (env/openfoam/org14).

evidence.utilities: command -v in env/openfoam/com2606/usr/lib/openfoam/openfoam2606/etc/bashrc (2026-11-26): surfaceFeatures is absent, everything else is present
evidence.snappyKeys: etc/caseDicts/annotated/snappyHexMeshDict: gapLevel:341, gapLevelIncrement:215/289, gapMode:347, curvatureLevel:275, leakLevel:260, useLeakClosure:538, levelIncrement:363/386, locationsInMesh:474, insidePoints:235, layerFields:888

etc/caseDicts/annotated/snappyHexMeshDict (6/2/1/1/1/2/2/2 matches) + src/mesh/snappyHexMesh: gapMode 4 files, curvatureLevel 2, leakLevel 2, useLeakClosure 2, levelIncrement 3, locationsInMesh 6; outsidePoints — snappyVoxelMeshDriver.C:473

evidence.utilities: command -v in env/openfoam/org14/opt/openfoam14/etc/bashrc (2026-11-26): PDRblockMesh, foamyHexMesh, foamyQuadMesh, refineHexMesh, setSet, surfaceMeshExtract and all of cfMesh are absent; surfaceFeatureExtract exists but is a stub (exp-019)
evidence.snappyKeys: src/mesh/snappyHexMesh: gapLevel — refinementSurfaces.H:86/104 and meshRefinementRefine.C:1788 (present!); gapLevelIncrement — refinementSurfaces.H:104; insidePoints — refinementParameters.C:84, outsidePoints — refinementParameters.C:94; gapMode/curvatureLevel/leakLevel/useLeakClosure/levelIncrement/locationsInMesh — 0 files. The org14 annotated dictionary has only gapLevelIncrement (lines 184, 219)

notes: gapLevel and gapLevelIncrement exist in BOTH lines — the plan's matrix (§3) is right only about gapMode.

outsidePoints (select cells outside) also exists in org14 — the key is not com-only; it is undocumented in the com2606 annotated dictionary, so declared=false and the live dictionary probe reports false.
PDRblockMesh, foamyHexMesh, foamyQuadMesh, refineHexMesh, setSet, surfaceMeshExtract and all of cfMesh are com-only; org14 has them neither as binaries nor as routes.
locationsInMesh with region names is com-only; the class does not exist in org14 at all (0 files in src).
distributionType (distributedTriSurfaceMesh) is com2606 only: the key is absent from the 2512 tutorials and present in 2606 (case distributedTriSurfaceMesh).
surfaceFeatures + system/surfaceFeaturesDict are org14 only; surfaceFeatureExtract on org14 is a stub (rc=0, writes no files, exp-019).
